agents.name: Ads Agent
agents.daily: Reads spend, cost per lead and creative performance every day. Flags fatigue, drafts new angles and variants, and proposes where the budget should move next.
agents.approval: Budget changes, new campaigns and every ad before it goes live.

agents.name: Social & Content Agent
agents.daily: Tracks trends and competitor content, drafts posts and captions in English, Chinese and Malay, and keeps the content calendar full.
agents.approval: Every post published under your brand name.

agents.name: Video Agent
agents.daily: Turns offers and winning hooks into short-video scripts, storyboards and AI-generated cuts, so creative testing never waits for a shoot day.
agents.approval: Final cuts, product claims and any use of people or brand assets.

agents.name: Email Agent
agents.daily: Segments the list, drafts sequences and follow-ups, tests subject lines and watches deliverability and unsubscribes.
agents.approval: Every send to your customer list.

agents.name: Web & Landing Page Agent
agents.daily: Builds and updates pages, keeps the page message matched to the ad that sent the visitor, and finds the friction that stops enquiries.
agents.approval: Page launches, offers and pricing shown to customers.

agents.name: Search Agent
agents.daily: Monitors Google rankings and how ChatGPT, Gemini and AI Overviews answer your buyers’ questions, then drafts answer-first content, FAQs and schema to close the gaps.
agents.approval: Published content and every factual claim about your business.

agents.name: Reporting Agent
agents.daily: Pulls the numbers together each day, writes a plain-language weekly summary and points to the one constraint worth fixing next.
agents.approval: Recommendations and the priorities for the next round.

loop.title: Read the data
loop.copy: The Reporting Agent pulls ad, site and lead data every day, not once a month.

loop.title: Decide the next test
loop.copy: Agents propose what to test, pause or scale, based on what the numbers actually show.

loop.title: Create the assets
loop.copy: Copy, images, short videos, emails and pages are drafted in hours instead of weeks.

loop.title: Wayne reviews
loop.copy: Brand, budget and compliance are checked by a human before anything reaches your customers.

loop.title: Launch and learn
loop.copy: Approved work goes live, results flow back in, and the loop starts again tomorrow.

guardrails.title: A human approves what customers see
guardrails.copy: Ads, posts, emails and pages are reviewed by Wayne before launch. Agents draft and recommend; they do not publish on their own.

guardrails.title: Budgets have hard limits
guardrails.copy: Spend caps and change limits are agreed with you first. No agent can raise a budget beyond them.

guardrails.title: Your data stays yours
guardrails.copy: Customer data is handled in line with Malaysia’s PDPA. You are told which tools process it, and ad accounts and assets remain in your name.

guardrails.title: No inflated promises
guardrails.copy: AI makes the work faster and the testing broader. It does not guarantee rankings, leads or sales, and I will not say it does.
